entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. I bought this thing over two months ago and I finally got around to trying it on and it's the wrong size. It's way too tight. This is ridiculous, your sizing charts are a joke.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the order here for the Apex Pro jersey, delivered about 69 days ago. So, just to confirm, the issue is that the fit is too tight?

Is that not what I just said? Yes, it's too tight! I need to either return it or get an exchange for a size that actually fits a human being. If you tell me I'm out of luck, I swear I will light up your company on every review site and I want to speak to your manager right now!
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for that. Please allow me to check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I've just confirmed our policy.
You're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so since it's only been 69 days, you are well within the window. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? No hassle?
No hassle at all. I can set up an exchange for the same jersey in a larger size, or I can process a full refund for you once the original item is returned. Which would you prefer?
Well... an exchange would be good. I do like the jersey, it was just the wrong size. I need an XL.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange order for an XL. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and your new one will ship out as soon as we receive it. Can I help with anything else?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
